answer: Give each agent a different small check task every epoch, drawn from a hidden pool with known answers, like rating a juniper photo for blight. The nectar is paid only for correct work. A sybil farm cannot reuse one solution across clones, since no two identities get the same task, so each fake costs the same real compute as an honest agent. The schedule works as a trellis: identities that skip or fail checks lose their seat, so a farm earns nothing extra per dollar spent.
